name: Named database document namespaces
description: Lets one project hold several Firestore databases, each with its own database ID, so documents, indexes and Security Rules in one database stay separate from the others.

name: Get one document
description: Reads a single document by its full resource path and returns its fields with its create and update times, or a not-found error when no document exists there.

name: Create a document
description: Creates a new document in a collection, using a caller-supplied or server-generated document ID, and fails if a document already exists at that path.

name: Update a document
description: Updates or inserts a document at a path. With an update mask, only the listed fields change, and listed fields missing from the input are removed.

name: Delete a document
description: Deletes the document at a path, optionally only if a precondition holds, such as the document existing or having a particular update time.

name: List documents
description: Lists the documents in a collection under a parent path one page at a time, with optional page size, field mask and read time.

name: Batch-get documents
description: Reads many documents by path in one request and streams back each document found or a marker for each missing one, optionally inside a transaction or at a past time.

name: Atomic multi-write Commit
description: Applies a list of writes atomically, so all of them take effect or none do, and returns a result for each write along with the commit time.

name: BatchWrite independent write statuses
description: Applies a batch of writes without atomicity, in any order and at most one per document, and returns a separate status for each write.

name: Field-mask projection
description: Limits a read to the fields listed in a document mask, so the returned document contains only those fields instead of the whole document.

name: Nested and quoted field paths
description: Addresses a field inside nested maps with a dot-separated path, and quotes field names containing special characters with backticks so any field can be referenced.

name: Server timestamp transforms
description: Sets a field to the time at which the server processed the request, rather than a time supplied by the client.

name: Numeric increment transforms
description: Atomically adds a number to a numeric field on the server, and sets the field to that number when it is missing or not numeric.

name: Array-union transforms
description: Appends elements to an array field only when they are not already in it, and starts a new array when the field is missing or not an array.

name: Array-remove transforms
description: Removes every occurrence of the given elements from an array field, and leaves an empty array when the field is missing or not an array.

name: Typed integer versus floating-point values
description: Stores whole numbers as 64-bit signed integers and fractional numbers as 64-bit double-precision floats, as two distinct numeric value types.

name: GeoPoint typed round trip
description: Stores a latitude and longitude pair as a geographic point value and returns the same point when the document is read back.

name: Document-reference typed values
description: Stores a reference to another document as a field value, holding the full resource path of that document.

name: Missing-parent subcollection routing
description: Allows a document to be written in a subcollection even though its parent document was never created, because a subcollection path does not require its parent to exist.

name: List collection IDs at a historical time
description: Lists the IDs of the collections directly under a document or the database root as they were at a chosen past read time.

name: Equality filters
description: Returns only documents whose field is exactly equal to a given value, such as a string, number or reference.

name: Range and inequality filters
description: Matches documents whose field is less than, at most, greater than, at least, or not equal to a value, and can combine bounds to select a range.

name: IN filters
description: Matches documents whose field equals any one of the values in a list given in the filter.

name: NOT_IN filters
description: Matches documents where the field exists, is not null, and differs from every value in a list given in the filter.

name: OR filters
description: Combines several filters with a logical OR, so a document matches when at least one of them is true.

name: Array-contains filters
description: Matches documents whose array field holds a given value as one of its elements.

name: Array-contains-any filters
description: Matches documents whose array field holds at least one of the values in a list of candidates.

name: Collection-group queries
description: Queries all collections that share one collection ID, wherever they sit in the database, as a single query.

name: Explicit query ordering
description: Sorts query results by one or more fields, each ascending or descending, with later fields breaking ties between earlier ones.

name: Start/end query cursors
description: Starts or ends a query at a position given by field values, either just before or just after them, so ordered results can be read in pages.

name: Query limits
description: Restricts a query to return no more than a chosen number of documents, counted from the start of the sort order.

name: Query offsets
description: Skips a given number of leading documents of a query before returning results, though skipped documents still count as reads.

name: Document-key query constraints
description: Filters or orders a query on the document key, written __name__, for example to select a range of document IDs.

name: Count aggregation
description: Returns how many documents match a query, without reading and returning the documents themselves.

name: Sum aggregation
description: Returns the total of a numeric field across all documents matching a query.

name: Average aggregation
description: Returns the arithmetic mean of a numeric field across all documents matching a query.

name: Multiple aggregates in one request
description: Computes several aggregations, such as count, sum and average, over the same query in a single request.

name: Query partitioning cursors
description: Splits a collection group query into partitions by returning cursors at the split points, so separate workers can run the pieces in parallel.

name: ListDocuments ordering by fields
description: Sorts the documents of a list request by an order-by string such as priority desc, instead of the default order by document name.

name: Ordered ListDocuments continuation
description: Returns the next page of an ordered list request when given the page token from the previous response, keeping the same sort order.

name: Name-only descending ListDocuments
description: Lists documents in reverse document-name order by ordering on __name__ descending, with no field-based ordering.

name: Omitted-collection direct-child listing
description: Lists documents from all collections directly under a parent when no collection ID is given, instead of from one named collection.

name: Omitted-collection field ordering
description: Applies a field-based sort to a list request that covers every collection under a parent because no collection ID was given.

name: Omitted-collection missing-document synthesis
description: With show-missing set, a list across all collections under a parent also returns nonexistent documents that have nested subdocuments, as entries with a key but no fields.

name: Euclidean nearest-neighbor distance
description: Finds the stored vectors closest to a query vector by straight-line Euclidean distance, where a smaller distance means a closer match.

name: Cosine nearest-neighbor distance
description: Finds the stored vectors most similar to a query vector by the angle between them, using cosine distance, which ignores vector length.

name: Dot-product nearest-neighbor distance
description: Finds the stored vectors most similar to a query vector by their dot product, which reflects both the angle between them and their lengths.

name: Nearest-neighbor distance thresholds
description: Keeps only nearest-neighbor results whose distance passes a set threshold, so weakly related documents are left out of the results.

name: Nearest-neighbor distance projection
description: Writes each nearest-neighbor result's computed distance into a chosen output field of the returned document.

name: Nested-field nearest-neighbor lookup
description: Runs a nearest-neighbor search on a vector field stored inside a map, addressed by its dotted field path.

name: Initial document listener snapshot
description: Opens a listen stream on specific documents and first sends their current contents, before streaming any later changes.

name: Initial query listener snapshot
description: Opens a listen stream on a query and first sends every matching document, followed by a marker that the result set is current.

name: Incremental listener document changes
description: Streams only the documents added, modified or removed since the previous snapshot of a listened target, instead of resending the whole result.

name: Limit-query listener refill
description: Keeps a listener on a limited query full: when a document drops out of the results, the next matching document is brought in to take its place.

name: Listen resume-token catch-up
description: Lets a listener reconnect with a resume token and receive only the changes made since that token, instead of the full result set.

name: Listen read-time catch-up
description: Starts a listen target after a chosen read time, so the stream sends only changes made since then, given the client already holds the earlier state.

name: Listen expected-count reconciliation
description: Tells the server how many documents the client last held for a target, so the server can check whether the resumed result set still matches.

name: Listen unchanged_names Bloom filter
description: Sends a Bloom filter holding the names of all documents that match a listened target, which a client can use to find cached documents that no longer match.

name: Write stream committed-acknowledgement replay
description: Lets a client resume a Write stream with its stream ID and the token of the last response it received, continuing from that position in the stream.

name: Create composite-index metadata
description: Creates a composite index over several fields of a collection group, starting a long-running build, and returns the operation that tracks it.

name: Get composite-index metadata
description: Reads one composite index by name, returning its query scope, fields and current state.

name: List composite-index metadata
description: Lists the composite indexes of a collection group one page at a time, optionally narrowed by a filter.

name: Delete composite-index metadata
description: Deletes a composite index by name, so queries can no longer be served from it.

name: Single-field ascending index configuration
description: Sets a field's index to ascending order, which serves equality, range and ascending-sort queries on that field.

name: Single-field descending index configuration
description: Sets a field's index to descending order, which serves equality, range and descending-sort queries on that field.

name: Single-field array index configuration
description: Sets a field's index to array-contains mode, which serves array-contains and array-contains-any queries on the elements of an array field.

name: Single-field index exemption
description: Turns off some or all automatic single-field indexes for a field, overriding the default indexing that every field otherwise gets.

name: Inherited single-field configuration
description: Reports that a field has no index settings of its own and follows the configuration of its ancestor field.

name: Required composite-index rejection for queries
description: Fails a query that needs a composite index which does not exist, with an error that describes the index to create.

name: Required-index rejection for aggregations
description: Fails an aggregation query, such as count or sum, when no index covers its filters and ordering, with an error naming the missing index.

name: Required-index rejection for query listeners
description: Fails a real-time listener on a query when an index it needs is missing, so the listener receives an error instead of results.

name: Equality index merging
description: Answers a query with several equality filters by merging separate single-field indexes, which avoids needing a dedicated composite index.

name: Asynchronous composite-index build
description: Builds a new composite index in the background as a long-running operation, with the index in a creating state until it becomes ready.

name: Reject non-READY indexes for serving
description: Serves queries from an index only once its state is READY, never while it is still being built.

name: Failed index build and NEEDS_REPAIR state
description: Marks an index whose creation went wrong as NEEDS_REPAIR, a state with no active build operation where the most recent build failed.

name: Cancel an index build
description: Requests cancellation of an in-progress index build by cancelling the long-running operation that is creating the index, on a best-effort basis.

name: Asynchronous single-field configuration
description: Applies a change to a field's index configuration as a long-running operation, so the new settings take effect only when it finishes.

name: Enforce index-entry count per document
description: Rejects a write that would give one document more index entries, across all of its indexes, than the per-document maximum allows.

name: Enforce scalar index-entry size
description: Rejects a write when a single index entry of a document would be larger than the maximum index entry size.

name: Enforce total index bytes per document
description: Rejects a write when the combined size of all index entries of one document would exceed the per-document maximum.

name: Indexed field value size limit
description: Indexes only the leading bytes of a very large field value, so queries on it can return inconsistent results, while the stored value stays complete.

name: Flat vector-index configuration
description: Creates a flat vector index on a vector field with a fixed number of dimensions, so nearest-neighbor queries can run on that field.

name: Require a vector index for FindNearest
description: Fails a nearest-neighbor query when no vector index covers its vector field and dimension, with an error describing the index to create.

name: Query Explain plan-only
description: Returns the plan Firestore would use for a query, including the indexes it would read, without running the query.

name: Query Explain analyze
description: Runs a query and returns execution statistics, such as the time taken and the read operations performed, along with its results.

name: Aggregation Explain plan-only
description: Returns the plan Firestore would use for an aggregation query such as count, sum or average, without running it.

name: Aggregation Explain analyze
description: Executes an aggregation query and reports how it ran, such as its duration and read operations, along with the aggregate results.

name: Explain plan_summary.indexes_used
description: Lists the indexes chosen for a query, each with its query scope and indexed properties, in the plan summary of an Explain report.

name: Explain debug_stats.index_entries_scanned
description: Reports how many index entries a query scanned while running, as one of the debug statistics of an analyze report.

name: Explain debug_stats.documents_scanned
description: Reports how many documents a query scanned while running, as one of the debug statistics of an analyze report.

name: Explain billing_details
description: Reports billing metrics for an analyzed query, such as billable documents, billable index entries and the minimum query cost.

name: Pessimistic read/write transactions
description: Runs reads and writes in a transaction that locks the documents it reads, so other writers must wait until the transaction finishes.

name: Read-only transaction snapshots
description: Starts a read-only transaction whose reads all see one consistent snapshot of the database, and which cannot write.

name: Optimistic read/write execution
description: Runs a read-write transaction without locking the documents it reads, and applies its writes only if none of those documents changed, otherwise retrying.

name: Configure database default concurrency mode
description: Sets the database-wide default concurrency mode, optimistic or pessimistic, that read-write transactions use unless one chooses otherwise.

name: Explicit per-transaction mode override
description: Lets a single read-write transaction choose optimistic or pessimistic locking instead of the database default.

name: Document-size validation
description: Rejects a write that would make a document larger than the maximum document size.
notes: Selected boundaries, not every production limit.

name: Value-size validation
description: Rejects a single field value, such as a long string or bytes value, that is larger than the maximum size allowed for one value.

name: Nesting-depth validation
description: Rejects a document whose maps are nested deeper than the maximum allowed depth.

name: API request size limit
description: Rejects a request whose body is larger than the maximum API request size.

name: Document storage-size accounting
description: Computes a document's stored size from its name, field names and values using documented per-type byte sizes, which count toward the document size limit.

name: Field-transform count limit
description: Limits how many field transforms, such as increments or array unions, a single document can have in one commit or transaction.

name: Document-name size limit
description: Limits the size of a document's full resource name, so a path that is too long is rejected.

name: Historical read_time precision and window
description: Reads data as of a past read_time, which must be a microsecond-precision timestamp inside the allowed retention window.

name: Serializable transaction isolation
description: Makes concurrent transactions behave as if they ran one at a time, so none can observe the intermediate state of another.

name: Transaction 270-second lifetime limit
description: Times out and fails a transaction that stays open for more than 270 seconds in total.

name: Transaction 60-second idle expiration
description: Times out and fails a transaction that has no reads or writes for 60 seconds.

name: Transaction 20-second lock deadline
description: Fails a transaction that exceeds the 20-second lock deadline, after which Firestore releases the locks the transaction was holding.

name: Enable/disable point-in-time recovery
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Turns point-in-time recovery on or off for a database, which controls whether past versions of its data are retained for recovery.

name: One-hour historical read retention policy
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Keeps past versions of documents for one hour by default, so reads can target any recent time within that hour.

name: Up-to-seven-day PITR read policy
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: With point-in-time recovery enabled, keeps past versions of documents for up to seven days, so reads can target a time in that window.

name: PITR whole-minute historical reads
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Requires a read time older than one hour to be a whole-minute timestamp inside the point-in-time recovery window.

name: Create a TTL field policy
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Enables time-to-live on a timestamp field of a collection group, so documents are deleted automatically once the time in that field has passed.

name: Get a TTL field policy
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Reads a field's configuration, including whether a TTL policy is set on it and what state that policy is in.

name: List TTL field policies
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Lists the fields that have a TTL policy by filtering a listing of field configurations, one page at a time.

name: Disable a TTL policy
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Removes the TTL policy from a field, so documents are no longer deleted automatically based on its timestamp.

name: Automatic expired-document deletion
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Deletes documents in the background after the timestamp in their TTL field has passed, without any delete request from a client.

name: TTL deletion preserves subcollections
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Deleting an expired document through TTL does not delete the subcollections beneath it, which stay in place.

name: Create backup schedules
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Creates a schedule that backs up a database automatically every day or every week, with a retention period for the backups it takes.

name: Get backup schedules
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Reads one backup schedule by name, returning its recurrence, retention period and creation time.

name: List backup schedules
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Lists all backup schedules defined for a database.

name: Update backup schedules
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Changes an existing backup schedule, such as how long its backups are retained, using an update mask.

name: Delete backup schedules
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Deletes a backup schedule so it takes no further backups, while the backups it already created are kept.

name: Execute a daily backup schedule
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Takes a backup of the database once a day under a daily schedule, keeping each backup for the schedule's retention period.

name: Execute a weekly backup schedule
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Takes a backup of the database once a week, on the chosen day of the week, under a weekly schedule.

name: Get retained backup metadata
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Reads the metadata of one backup, such as its source database, snapshot time, expiry time and state.

name: List retained backups
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Lists the backups of a project in a location, with the metadata of each one.

name: Delete retained backups
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Deletes a single backup by name, so it can no longer be used to restore a database.

name: Expire retained backups
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Removes a backup automatically once its expiration time has passed.

name: RestoreDatabase into a fresh destination
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Creates a new database from an existing backup, in the same location as that backup, as a long-running operation.

name: PITR CloneDatabase
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Creates a new database from a point-in-time snapshot of an existing database, taken at a whole-minute time inside the recovery window.

name: Managed ExportDocuments
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Exports documents to a Cloud Storage location as a long-running operation, either all collections or only the collection IDs listed.

name: Managed ImportDocuments
area: TTL, historical reads, backups and recovery
description: Imports documents into a database from files in Cloud Storage that an earlier export wrote, overwriting existing documents of the same name.

name: Create Native Standard databases through Admin
description: Creates a Firestore database in Native mode, Standard edition, with a chosen database ID and location, as a long-running operation.

name: Get database metadata through Admin
description: Reads one database's settings, such as its location, type, concurrency mode, recovery settings and delete protection.

name: List database metadata through Admin
description: Lists all Firestore databases in a project, each with its settings.

name: Update database deletion protection
description: Turns delete protection on or off for a database, which blocks deleting it while protection is enabled.

name: Delete databases with protection checks
description: Deletes a database, but refuses to do so while its delete protection is enabled.

name: Inspect owned long-running operations
description: Gets or lists the status of long-running operations, such as index builds, exports and restores, that were started on a database.

name: Cancel supported owned long-running operations
description: Asks the server to cancel a running long-running operation, such as an index build, on a best-effort basis.

name: Evaluate document Security Rules
description: Checks each client read and write of a document against the deployed Security Rules, allowing it only when a matching rule grants access.

name: Enforce query authorization proof
description: Allows a query only when Security Rules would grant access to every document it could return, judged from the query's own constraints rather than its results.

name: Isolate Rules by database
description: Applies a separate Security Rules release to each database in a project, so the rules of one database do not affect another.

name: Rules typed path binding
description: Represents a resource location as a typed Path value in a rule, and fills the variables of a path pattern from a map with the bind method.

name: Rules bool(string) conversion
description: Converts a string such as true into a boolean value in a rule expression, using the bool function.

name: Rules math.isInfinite(number)
description: Returns true when a number in a rule expression is positive or negative infinity.

name: Rules document-access budgets
description: Caps how many document lookups, such as get and exists calls, one request's rule evaluation may make, with a higher cap for multi-document requests.

name: Rules function argument limit (7)
description: Allows a function defined in Security Rules to take at most seven arguments.

name: Rules function let-binding limit (10)
description: Allows a function defined in Security Rules to declare at most ten let variable bindings.

name: Rules path capture limit (20)
description: Allows at most twenty path capture variables across the nested match statements of Security Rules.

name: Rules String.split(regex)
description: Splits a string at each match of a regular expression and returns the pieces as a list.

name: Rules String.replace(regex, substitution)
description: Replaces every match of a regular expression in a string with a substitution string and returns the result.

name: Rules String.matches(regex)
description: Returns true when the whole string matches a regular expression.

name: Rules REST rulesets.create
description: Creates an immutable ruleset from rules source and returns it under a unique generated name; nothing enforces it until a release refers to it.

name: Rules REST rulesets.get
description: Reads one ruleset by its resource name, returning its source files.

name: Rules REST rulesets.list
description: Lists the rulesets of a project one page at a time, returning only their metadata and optionally filtered.

name: Rules REST rulesets.delete
description: Deletes a ruleset by its resource name, which fails while a release still refers to it.

name: Rules REST releases.create
description: Creates a named release that refers to a ruleset, so that rules-enabled services such as Firestore can enforce that ruleset.

name: Rules REST releases.get
description: Reads one release by its resource name, returning the ruleset it points to and its create and update times.

name: Rules REST releases.list
description: Lists the releases of a project one page at a time, optionally filtered by release name or ruleset name.

name: Rules REST releases.patch
description: Updates an existing release to point to a different ruleset, which switches the rules in force for its target.

name: Rules REST releases.delete
description: Deletes a release by its resource name, ending the link between its target and the ruleset.

name: Rules REST projects.test
description: Checks Security Rules source, or an existing ruleset, for syntax and semantic problems and runs test cases against it, returning issues and results.

name: Rules source-test VISITED expression reports
description: Makes a rules test report only the expressions that were visited during evaluation, each with its location and evaluated value.

name: Rules source-test FULL expression reports
description: Makes a rules test return detailed reporting on the expressions evaluated for each test case, with where each appears and what it evaluated to.

name: Rules REST releases.getExecutable
description: Returns the compiled executable form of the ruleset a release points to, which an enforcement engine can run.

name: ExecutePipeline (Native Enterprise)
area: Production security, editions and service guarantees
description: Runs a pipeline query, built from ordered stages such as where, sort and aggregate, on an Enterprise edition database and returns the results.
notes: Current edition option; Google stage coverage not established.

name: CMEK database configuration
area: Production security, editions and service guarantees
description: Creates a database encrypted with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key named in its configuration, instead of a Google-managed key.
notes: Configured host key service accepts KMS references; no key material or cryptographic encryption in this engine.

name: IAM authorization for Firestore requests
area: Production security, editions and service guarantees
description: Allows or denies each Firestore request from server client libraries and APIs according to the IAM roles and permissions granted to the caller.
notes: Host IAM admission; standalone credentials and host enforcement are not the complete managed IAM service.

name: CMEK unavailable-key access denial
area: Production security, editions and service guarantees
description: Makes requests to a CMEK database fail with FAILED_PRECONDITION while its key version is disabled or destroyed or Firestore may not use the key.
notes: Configured engine enforces host key availability.

name: CMEK key-version rotation
area: Production security, editions and service guarantees
description: When the Cloud KMS key is rotated, re-encrypts the database with the key's latest primary version, keeping the old version available until that finishes.
notes: Durable reference-state transitions; no cryptographic re-encryption claim.

name: CMEK backup and restore key prerequisites
area: Production security, editions and service guarantees
description: Encrypts backups of a CMEK database with the key version in use when they are taken, and lets a restore keep that encryption, use a new key, or use Google default encryption.
notes: Source/destination key checks; compatibility recovery only.

name: App Check enforcement for Firestore
area: Production security, editions and service guarantees
description: Rejects Firestore requests from mobile and web apps that lack a valid App Check token proving they come from your genuine app, once enforcement is on.

name: Document-created event triggers
area: Production security, editions and service guarantees
description: Runs a function when a document is first created at a matching path, passing the new document's data to the function.

name: Document-updated event triggers
area: Production security, editions and service guarantees
description: Runs a function when an existing document changes, passing the document's values from before and after the change.

name: Document-deleted event triggers
area: Production security, editions and service guarantees
description: Runs a function when a document is deleted, passing the document's data as it was just before the deletion.
